rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice when the person is generous and gracious rather than petty.

example.english: They are really magnanimous and always treat us to meals.
example.traditional: 佢真係好大方，成日請我哋食飯。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 daai6 fong1 seng4 jat6 ceng2 ngo5 dei6 sik6 faan6

rows.note: Use this for the more specific sense of nobly forgiving an insult or overlooking someone’s fault.

example.english: You offended them this time, but they can still forgive you; they are truly magnanimous.
example.traditional: 你今次咁樣得罪佢，佢仲可以原諒你，真係寬宏大量。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam1 ci3 gam3 joeng2 dak1 zeoi6 keoi5 keoi5 zung6 ho2 ji5 jyun4 loeng6 nei5 zan1 hai6 fun1 wang4 daai6 loeng6
